title: Non-Definability of Reachability in Büchi Arithmetic for a Family of Generalized Collatz Maps
summary: Let $q \ge 3$ and $d \ge 1$ be odd integers with $q+d$ a power of $2$. We study the generalized Collatz map $T_{q,d}$, a one-dimensional piecewise-affine map on the positive integers, and its unparameterized reachability relation $R(x,z)$, which holds when $z$ is an iterate of $x$ under $T_{q,d}$. We prove that for every such pair $(q,d)$ the relation $R$ is not first-order definable in Büchi arithmetic $\langle \mathbb{N}, +, V_q \rangle$.
